title: Viewing your Forex Card on NetBanking
sample_queries: Where can I see my forex card?
How do I check my forex card details online?
Can I view my forex card on NetBanking?
answer: You can view your Forex Card details by going to Cards, then selecting Forex Card.

title: Reloading a Forex Card
sample_queries: How do I reload my forex card?
I need to add money to my forex card
Can I top up my forex card online?
answer: You can reload your Forex Card by going to Cards, then Forex Card, and selecting Reload Card for the card in question.

title: Managing a Forex Card
sample_queries: How do I manage my forex card settings?
Where do I manage my forex card?
I want to change something on my forex card
answer: You can manage your Forex Card by going to Cards, then Forex Card, and selecting Manage Card for the card in question.

title: Purchasing a new Forex Card
sample_queries: How do I buy a forex card?
Can I apply for a forex card online?
I want to get a forex card for my trip
answer: You can apply for a Forex Card by going to Cards, then Forex Card, and selecting Buy Forex Card under Quick Links.
